function.name: e2e_data_platform_readiness
function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A1.1 Data Platform Readiness] Assess whether your data infrastructure can support real-time asset monitoring, automated SLA calculation, and ESG reporting before an EaaS contract goes live. Outputs: Data readiness audit across six dimensions; Gap remediation roadmap with cost estimates; Go/no-go recommendation for EaaS deployment; Data governance framework for IoT and operational data.

asset_type.description: Type of industrial asset to be monitored (e.g. compressor, HVAC, conveyor)

data_sources.description: Existing data sources and systems (SCADA, ERP, CMMS, etc.)

sla_requirements.description: Performance KPIs and SLA targets the contract must measure
